literal: Context having known, well having perceived, let speak; of words the course who knew, goodness they.
translation: Let the good people who know the proper usage of words speak only after understanding the context and perceiving the audience well.
modern: சொற்களின் நடையை அறிந்த நல்லவர்கள், அவையின் தன்மையை அறிந்து நன்கு உணர்ந்த பின்பே பேச வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of understanding one's audience before speaking. The phrase 'சொல்லின் நடை' refers to the proper course or usage of words, highlighting the skill of effective communication. The word 'இடை' denotes the context or the assembly. The poet stresses that even good people who master vocabulary must carefully perceive the situation to ensure their words are appropriate and well-received.
